title: Kissed American Cheese Soup
description: A cultured, gooey soup that blends classic American cheese with a subtle kick of chili powder and a mother-sauce base, ideal for a comforting sick-day meal.
instructions: Melt the butter in a medium pot over medium heat until foamy.
Add the tomato paste and stir until fragrant about 1 minute.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the milk and allow the mixture to heat through.
Add the shredded cheddar and cream cheese, stirring until melted and smooth.
Season with chili powder, salt, and black pepper and adjust to taste.
Remove from heat and let the soup sit for 2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped chives before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
